Subject: Renewal forecast & churn-risk bucket update

Team —

Quick reminder as we wrap Q3 forecasting: I need updated stage and commit indicators for all renewal opportunities where the current renewal date is within the next 90 days. Primary asks: 

- Move any accounts with confirmed procurement PO/commit to "Commit" and flag the expected PO date.
- Put accounts where the customer is still evaluating pricing or has requested extended pricing review into the "At Risk" bucket with a short note on the blocker.
- Anything that is showing as "Likely" but without confirmed finance approval should be labeled "Watch" and include the last customer contact date.

Please update the attached Renewal_Plan_Q3.xlsx and push the HubSpot record for ACME: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-987 by EOD Friday. I will be pulling the consolidated numbers for finance on Monday morning.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Adding two quick items from CS that matter for the risk buckets: 

- ACME reported elevated error rates in their production tenant last week; CS asked for a follow-up health check. If the customer ties renewal to SLA remediation, bump to "At Risk" until remediation is scheduled.
- For two other mid-market renewals (listed in the spreadsheet), CS has already agreed to a short-term credit to preserve relationship; mark those as "Watch" with the credit note.

- Finance has approved the spend; legal review of the data retention addendum is expected to finish by 8/31.

- We did open a support ticket for the elevated error rates (SUP-5581) and CS has been responsive. If the issue is resolved within the next two weeks we will proceed with the planned renewal.

I'll upload the MRR breakdown you requested once I get sign-off (attaching a summary now).

Best,
